subject: [PATCH v5 09/11] mm, swap: add debugfs counters for vswap

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch adds two debugfs counters to track virtual swap usage in the Linux kernel. The first counter, 'used', tracks the number of virtual swap slots (pages) currently allocated. The second counter, 'alloc_reject', counts the cumulative pages that failed to get a vswap slot. These counters are exposed under the '/sys/kernel/debug/vswap/' directory and can be accessed via debugfs. This patch addresses the need for visibility into virtual swap usage statistics, which is useful for debugging and performance analysis.
